title: Treatment of single operational upset.
bodyText: For the purpose of this part, a single operational upset which leads to simultaneous violations of more than one water pollutant parameter shall be treated as a single violation.
bodyHtml: [§342D-36]  Treatment of single operational upset.  For the purpose of this part, a single operational upset which leads to simultaneous violations of more than one water pollutant parameter shall be treated as a single violation. [L 1989, c 212, pt of §2]
